_notes: Musician data for weddingday2.ie. 'events' uses: ceremony (ceremony & drinks reception), day2, afterdinner. 'tradBand' and 'duo' are true/false. Add a musician's videos as {id, seconds} using the Squarespace video ID. Photos are Squarespace image paths after imageBase. Do not add prices here: this file is public. Optional 'photoPosition' (e.g. 'center 4%') moves the crop of a tall photo so the face stays in the wide banner. Each video has 'shape': 'tall' (filmed upright) or 'wide'. A video can have an optional 'poster' (a Squarespace image path) to replace its automatic thumbnail.

musicians.name: Lee
bio: Lee is a professional singer-guitarist specialising in weddings and private events. Blending modern hits, classic anthems and Irish favourites, he delivers high-energy, singalong sets tailored to each event.
Known for seamless medleys and having fun with the crowd, he keeps the dance floor full from start to finish and happily takes requests.

musicians.name: Matthew
bio: Hailing from the West of Ireland, Matthew is a seasoned musician known for bringing energy, atmosphere, and unforgettable live performances to weddings across the country.

With years of experience playing hundreds of weddings, appearances on national TV, and performances at major festivals, he combines powerful vocals with top-class guitar playing to keep every crowd entertained from start to finish.

musicians.name: Conor C
bio: With over eight years of experience and performances at more than 1000 weddings and events across Ireland, Conor has developed a versatile show that can be tailored to your specific needs.
Unlike most solo performers, Conor utilises a unique set of tools and techniques to create a fully live wedding music experience that cannot be replicated.

musicians.name: Conor T
bio: Conor has nearly a decade of experience performing at weddings and events across Ireland and internationally.
Through this, he has built a unique and lively sound which gives the energy of a full band in a more personal setup. He also covers a wide mix of hits to keep the day flowing.

musicians.name: Cathal
bio: Cathal is a professional singer and guitarist with over ten years experience on some of Ireland & The UK's biggest stages.
Whether you wish to create a relaxed, mellow atmosphere during the early stage of your Day Two, or an upbeat, feel-good vibe later into the night, Cathal has the setlist for you!
Cathal is also happy to work with couples on selecting the perfect soundtrack for their day, whether it's that favourite song or just simply a preferred genre.

musicians.name: Josh
bio: Josh is an incredibly talented musician who has performed at multiple weddings, Day 2's, and festivals all across Ireland.

Playing a mix of Irish favourites and dance classics on guitar, he creates the perfect atmosphere for any wedding day 2. With years of experience entertaining crowds, Josh brings great energy and plenty of craic to every event.

musicians.name: Emmett
bio: Emmett is a professional singer-guitarist specialising in weddings and private events across Ireland.

With a relaxed acoustic style and a repertoire spanning modern chart hits, timeless classics and Irish favourites he creates the perfect atmosphere for every event. Every performance is tailored to suit the guests, ensuring the music feels personal and memorable.

musicians.name: Alan
bio: Alan is a singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist who has won two National Song Contests as well as an IMRO award.
Alan has played with some of the biggest acts in Ireland and the UK including The Coronas, Mundy, 5ive and Aslan and has been playing music all over the world for the past 15 years.
He plays a wide range of music from the 60s up to the hits of today as well as some traditional music to make the perfect soundtrack to your day two.

musicians.name: Paddy
bio: Paddy is a Galway-based musician with over 10 years of experience playing at weddings and events.
He's known for keeping things relaxed while still getting people on the dance floor, mixing crowd favourites with a few personal touches, and the occasional harmonica thrown in.

musicians.name: Phil
bio: Whether it's upbeat party music or laid-back acoustic vibes, Phil has all the bases covered. With a huge repertoire of over 700 songs, Phil is more than happy to take requests and be your very own human jukebox.
Phil has toured and performed across the UK, Ireland, Europe and America as a guitarist and vocalist with the legendary Sinéad O'Connor, making him incredibly experienced and ideal for any occasion.

musicians.name: Craig
bio: Craig is a live musician known for his strong vocal ability and high-energy performances.
With a natural talent to read the crowd, he keeps the vibe upbeat and engaging from start to finish.
With years of experience entertaining crowds across Ireland, he has built a setlist featuring modern hits, creative mashups, and classic sing-along favourites.

musicians.name: Pauric
bio: Pauric is an incredibly gifted guitarist and outstanding singer who brings the perfect atmosphere to any wedding day 2 celebration.
His style blends popular contemporary songs with touches of traditional Irish music, creating a warm, lively, and memorable experience for guests of all ages.
Whether performing laid-back acoustic favourites or getting everyone up dancing and singing along, Pauric's talent, charm, and love of music make him a highlight of any wedding celebration.

musicians.name: Karl
bio: Karl is a Dublin-based singer, guitarist and multi-instrumentalist with over 18 years of professional performing experience.

Since beginning his career on the Irish pub circuit in 2008, Karl has gone on to perform at more than 1,000 weddings, drinks receptions, ceremonies, day-two celebrations, private events and corporate functions across Ireland, Europe and South America.

Whether it's creating the perfect atmosphere for a wedding ceremony, providing easy-listening music for a drinks reception, or getting a crowd singing along late into the evening, Karl tailors every performance to suit the occasion.

musicians.name: Andrew
bio: Andrew is an experienced Irish musician who has performed at weddings and events across Ireland and the U.S.

Known for his relaxed style and wide-ranging setlist, he adapts to every crowd, whether it's providing the perfect soundtrack for a drinks reception or wedding day 2, getting guests singing along later in the day.
He has an incredible voice and is passionate about live music, Andrew brings great energy to every event.

musicians.name: James
bio: James is a Cork-based singer and guitarist who brings great energy and plenty of personality to weddings and events across Ireland.

Whether you want a relaxed, laid-back soundtrack for your drinks reception or someone to get the whole crowd up singing and dancing later in the day, James reads the room and keeps the atmosphere just right from start to finish.

musicians.name: Cian
bio: Cian, a Mayo born musician, has been singing and playing the guitar for two decades and is a familiar face in the lively Temple Bar area.
He enjoys playing a mix of modern and classic songs in rock, pop, and folk styles. With dynamic and engaging performances, Cian has captivated music enthusiasts throughout Ireland and abroad.
